# WA4 · Thông báo nổi (toast)

Group **WA · Khung & điều hướng** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`(app shell)`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#toast`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#handle`
- The shell is drawn once by `clinic.js › shell(content)`: `.sidebar` (menu filtered by `PemaStaff.allowed(page)`), `.topbar` (breadcrumbs, demo account picker, global search, bell, reset), then the page body.
- `clinic.js › toast(msg)` removes any existing `.toast`, appends a `div.toast` to `body` and removes it after 2800 ms.
- Inventory note: Check-in and Vắng in the reception list act at once and show this toast; they open no dialog. After Check-in the row offers "Bắt đầu" (crm:start). The toast disappears after 2.8 s.
- Page key `today` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"today\"]"} → {"click":"[data-crm=\"arrive\"]"} → {"wait":".toast"}; it must show "Đã cập nhật hàng đợi".

## Differences from the app design
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in A7: "Đã cập nhật hàng đợi"

## Gotchas
- Role and page are kept in `sessionStorage` (`pema-staff`); a fresh browser context always starts as `owner-tam` unless `?staff=<id>` is in the URL.
- The toast is outside `#app`; the snapshot adds any visible `.toast` to the tree of every screen.
- The toast is a fixed pill at the bottom right of the viewport, above the page content; the page behind it ("Hôm nay", drawn in full at WB3) is only context.
- Check-in and Vắng act at once: the row's status badge changes and the buttons become "Bắt đầu" (Đã đến) or "Mời vào phòng" (Đang chờ); no dialog opens.
